presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: Three browns woven on tanned paper.
presets.description: The three band colors have to differ from each other, so a monochrome weave is really a three-step ladder. The accent line goes with them.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Three greys, no hue at all.
presets.description: The same three-step ladder without color. The weave structure carries the picture on its own.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: Background and all three bands take the same hue at different lightnesses, which is as close to two colors as the style's own constraints allow.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty bands instead of the bright ones.
presets.description: The style ships eight saturated band colors. This trades them for dusty tones, which turns the tartan from a beach towel into a wool blanket.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: The other direction on the same lever: six colors past anything the style ships.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: Changes only what the weave sits on. The lightest way to make a set feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall, strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient under the weave.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in, so fewer bands fill the frame.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. Fewer, larger bands read better at the size a comment thread gives an avatar.
